offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures CPAP and ventilation devices, masks and accessories for sleep apnea and chronic respiratory patients, sold to home medical equipment providers, hospitals and patients, with cloud software that tracks therapy data.

primary_products.value: CPAP devices; patient masks and accessories; home ventilators

primary_services.value: cloud-based patient data and therapy monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: home medical equipment providers, hospitals, sleep clinics, home care providers; B2C: patients with sleep apnea or chronic respiratory conditions who buy supplies directly

end_markets.value: healthcare; sleep medicine; respiratory care; home healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: devices, masks and accessories sold to providers and patients; subscription: cloud software subscriptions for clinics and providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds devices and masks from purchased components, sold to providers and patients; brand owner: designs and markets sleep and respiratory products under its own brands; software / platform: cloud platform for therapy data, sold to providers and clinics
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: sleep and respiratory devices, masks and accessories, and cloud patient software

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: home medical equipment dealers that supply patients; direct sales: sales teams selling to hospitals and large providers; online: online store selling supplies directly to some patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and other national medical device approvals, such as EU MDR
